title: Create analytics and a privacy page
description: A new GA4 property for Humorus with standard Consent Mode. The sites link to their own privacy page, not another company's.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Draft written and merged: project/wiki/analytics-and-privacy.md (PR #13). The GA4 consent standard as Papyrus implements it, what the Humorus site needs, the gaps in Papyrus (PPY-d0a3d5 consent per tenant, PPY-1252ce stored site config), and a draft privacy page with [CONFIRM] and [LEGAL REVIEW] markers. Person-only: Ryan creates the GA4 property under DataParade and the id goes into the site's Papyrus setting (placeholder <GA4-measurement-id>).
